mettle.perk.survival.gatherer.descriptio: Berries, herbs and wild plants you pick give a bonus item %s%% of the time.
mettle.perk.survival.quiet_approach.desc: While you sneak, animals don’t flee until you’re within 4 blocks.
mettle.perk.survival.skinner.description: Animals you kill drop one more meat and one more leather, hide, wool or feather.
mettle.perk.survival.stalker.description: A sneak attack on an animal that hasn’t noticed you kills it outright.
mettle.perk.survival.sixth_sense.descrip: A quickening heartbeat, heard only by you, warns you when a hostile within 16 blocks starts hunting you.
mettle.perk.survival.iron_stomach.descri: Raw meat, rotten flesh and spider eyes never poison you or give you Hunger.
mettle.perk.survival.campfire_rest.descr: Standing still beside a lit campfire heals a heart every 4 s.
mettle.perk.survival.pathfinder.descript: You move 15%% faster on paths and roads, and berry bushes no longer hurt or slow you.
mettle.perk.survival.tracker.description: Sneak still for 2 s to read the ground: the trail of the nearest wild animal within 96 blocks shows as faint prints only you can see, for 30 s.
mettle.perk.survival.lay_of_the_land.des: Every place you discover marks the nearest landmark you haven’t found on your locator bar, until you reach it.
mettle.perk.survival.living_off_the_land: Grass, ferns, bushes and leaves you break turn up something useful one time in six, and wild food fills you double.
mettle.perk.survival.weatherwise.descrip: A far-off rumble warns you 2 minutes before rain or a storm arrives.
mettle.perk.survival.weatherwise.hint: Every sky has its own weather.
mettle.perk.survival.big_game.descriptio: Big game you kill (elk, deer, mammoths, polar bears, hoglins, goats) drops double meat and hide.
mettle.perk.survival.big_game.hint: The deer are not the only ones who learn.
mettle.perk.survival.trailblazer.descrip: Discovering a new biome or place gives you Speed I and Regeneration I for 60 s.
mettle.perk.survival.poultice.descriptio: Sneak-use three herbs or flowers to bind a wound: heal 4 hearts over 8 s and cure poison (30 s cooldown).
mettle.perk.survival.poultice.hint: Taught by a city’s healer, or found in The Monks’ Herbal.
mettle.perk.general.seen_it_all.hint: There is always one more hill.
mettle.perk.general.pack_horse.hint: Nobody asked you to carry all that.
mettle.perk.general.jack_of_all_trades.d: Skills below level 10 gain XP 25%% faster.
mettle.perk.general.jack_of_all_trades.h: A little of everything goes a long way.
mettle.feedback.survival.wild_food: Living off the Land · wild food, double fill
mettle.feedback.survival.big_game: Big Game · double meat and hide
mettle.feedback.survival.sixth_sense: Sixth Sense · something is hunting you
mettle.feedback.survival.campfire_rest: Campfire Rest · resting by the fire
mettle.feedback.survival.lay_of_the_land: Lay of the Land · %s, %s blocks off
